This Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the Parties and their respective successors, heirs, executors, administrators and permitted assigns.
Neither Party may assign this Agreement in whole or in part or delegate its obligations under this Agreement in whole or in part without the prior written consent of the other Party.

(a) issue a press release or make any other public statement that references this Agreement, or
